title: Parliament and Provincial Assemblies Disqualification for Membership Amendment Act 1991

sections.shortTitle: Parliament and Provincial Assemblies Disqualification for Membership Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 1991
ACT VII OF 1991
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (DISQUALIFICATION FOR MEMBERSHIP)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend the Parliament and Provincial Assemblies
(Disqualification for Membership) Order, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th April, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 28th
April, 1991, and is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Disqualification for Membership)
(Amendment) Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Parliament and Provincial Assemblies Disqualification for Membership Amendment Act 1991
sections.description:
Insertion of new Article 6A, P. (P.P.) O. No. 17 of 1977

ACT VII OF 1991
ACT VII OF 1991
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (DISQUALIFICATION FOR MEMBERSHIP)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend the Parliament and Provincial Assemblies
(Disqualification for Membership) Order, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th April, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 28th
April, 1991, and is hereby published for general information:--
2. Insertion of new Article 6A, P. (P.P.) O. No. 17 of 1977.--In
the Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Disqualification for Membership)
Order, 1977 [P. (P.P.) O. No. 17 of 1977], hereinafter referred to as the said
Order, after Article 6, the following new Article shall be inserted, namely:--
"6-A.
Transfer of cases, etc.---(1) Where two or more Special Courts have been
established and the Supreme Court is satisfied that, for the general
convenience of the parties or witnesses or for the ends of justice, it is
expedient to do so, the Supreme Court may direct that a case specified by it
shall stand transferred from one Special Court to another.
(2) In respect
of a case transferred to a Special Court under clause (1), such Special Court
shall not, by reason of the said transfer, be bound to re-call and rehear any
witness who has given evidence in the case before the transfer and may act on
the evidence already recorded by or produced before the Special Court from
which the case is transferred: ".

Amendment of Article 7, P.(P.P.) O. No. 17 of 1977

ACT VII OF 1991

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend the Parliament and Provincial Assemblies
(Disqualification for Membership) Order, 1977
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 30th April, 1991]
The following Act of
Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent of the President on the 28th
April, 1991, and is hereby published for general information:--
3. Amendment of Article 7, P.(P.P.) O. No. 17 of 1977.--In the said
Order, in Article 7,--
(a) for the words and figure
"of a Special Court under Article 5" the comma and words
"decision or final order of a Special Court" shall be substituted;
and
(b) for the words "the
decision" the words and comma "such finding, decision or order"
shall be substituted; and
(c) the words "of the
Special Court" shall be omitted.

The following Act of

4. Addition of new Article 12, P. (P.P.) O. No. 17 of 1977.---In
the said Order, after Article 11, the following new Article shall be added,
namely:--
"12.
Repeal.--The Holders of Representative Offices (Prevention of Misconduct)
Act, 1976 (IV of 1977), and the Parliament and Provincial Assemblies
(Disqualification for Membership) Act, 1976 (V of 1977), are hereby repealed
and shall be deemed to have been so repealed on the sixth day of August,
1990.".
